_comment: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Qwen, and DeepSeek through the same plan). NOT VERIFIED: rename `alibaba-token-plan` to the id of your opencode provider for the plan (an OpenAI-compatible provider whose baseURL is the plan's compatible-mode endpoint), and add the provider (billing: subscription) and its models to .lean-worker/prices.json, or the launcher prices them at its unknown-model fallback. No quota adapter yet. DeepSeek on the same plan: e.g. alibaba-token-plan/deepseek-v4-pro. Merge the profiles you need into .lean-worker/profiles.json and replace the {build command} / {test command} placeholders. Each chain ends in Claude: it runs only when the operator gives the go on an `escalate:` line. Bash runs only the allowedTools patterns and every segment of a pipeline must match, so the common read-only helpers are pre-approved. Give code tasks --write-scope: these models have edited files outside the task's scope. Review a change with a model of another family than the one that wrote it (for example review-<other family>, or the base template's Claude review). Runtime is opencode (the plan has no Anthropic-compatible endpoint in the price book); when you escalate to Claude, add --runtime claude.
